leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a test data factory function that generates mock user objects with customizable properties
Implement a cleanup utility function that removes test data from a simulated database array
Configure the data factory to accept parameter overrides while maintaining default values
Integrate the factory and cleanup utilities within a test scenario to verify their functionality
Manipulate the factory's output to produce varied test cases for different user roles
Initialize a test runner that applies the factory to create data and uses the cleanup utility post-test
Apply the utilities in sequence to demonstrate a complete test setup and teardown workflow
lessonTitle: Build test data factory and cleanup utilities
